title: Spa & Wellness Treatments | Saltay Hanalei Bay
description: Explore Saltay’s signature spa experiences, immersive packages, acupuncture, botanical enhancements, and children’s offerings on Kaua‘i.
heading: Find your Saltay experience
introduction: A little time to reconnect. A whole afternoon to unwind. Explore botanical bodywork, holistic therapies, and personalized rituals, and find the experience that feels right for you.
hero_image_alt: Ocean waters along the coast of Kaua‘i
choices_introduction: Start with a signature ritual, settle into a longer spa journey, or explore a particular therapy.

categories.title: Signature Experiences
categories.description: Explore named rituals that bring together therapeutic bodywork, botanical applications, and holistic facial care. Discover experiences such as Pampered in Paradise, Divine Unwind, and Jewel of the Siren.
categories.image_alt: Therapeutic massage and botanical bodywork at Saltay

categories.title: Spa Packages
categories.description: Make room for a longer visit with several experiences woven into one journey. Explore packages that combine bodywork, facial rituals, and botanical care, including an experience created for two.
categories.image_alt: Holistic facial care as part of a Saltay spa experience

categories.title: Acupuncture & More
categories.description: Learn about acupuncture, acupressure, fire cupping, Tui Na bodywork, and other therapies offered at Saltay. Find out what each modality involves before choosing your session.

extras.title: Wellness Enhancements
extras.description: Personalize a signature experience or retreat with additions such as botanical compresses, aromatherapy acupressure, or sound frequency. Enhancements enrich your chosen session without extending its duration.

extras.title: Keiki (Children)
extras.description: Explore bodywork and botanical offerings for children, with a parent accompanying their session. Jewel of the Siren botanical facials are offered from age nine; see the Keiki page for available options.

expect_introduction: Botanicals, thoughtful touch, and time to settle in. Your chosen experience guides the therapies and amenities included in your visit.

steps.title: Begin with you
steps.description: Your therapist introduces your selected experience and the botanicals chosen for it. Share what you’re hoping for and settle into your time at Saltay.

steps.title: Receive your ritual
steps.description: Depending on your selection, your session may weave together bodywork, botanical applications, facial care, acupuncture, or other therapeutic modalities.

steps.title: Leave time to linger
steps.description: Some experiences include a botanical foot soak, infra-red sauna, or steam. Review your chosen offering to see what’s included, or ask us to help plan your visit.

booking_text: Tell us what you’re looking for, and we’ll help you choose an experience. Ready to reserve your time? Explore availability or browse our treatment pricing.
